capabilities: Open a PDF in a side-by-side Markdown pane
Generate a paginated Markdown draft from a PDF text layer
Sync character-level selections between Markdown and PDF
Auto-paginate an existing note against PDF page boundaries
Edit page blocks inline and save without losing scroll position
extras: README lists four key features with command names and shortcuts but gives no install steps, settings, or troubleshooting. Targets researchers, translators, and digital humanities scholars; matcher handles editorial notes like ［校按：...］ and OCR typos.
problem: Working with PDFs and OCR-generated Markdown notes requires constant manual scrolling and searching to keep the two texts aligned.
summary: Dual-pane workspace that pairs Markdown notes with PDFs, syncs text selections and pages, and generates paginated drafts from PDF text.
